title: Disentangling Representation using Attributes-based Gaussian Estimation for Medical Sound Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2608.29026v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning has a powerful capability of feature extraction. However, the lack of fairness and interpretability in deep neural networks poses limitations to their adoption in the medical domain. This paper proposes a disentangled representation learning (DisenRL) framework, named the Attributes-based Gaussian Estimation for Disentangled Representation (AGEDR), which incorporates Attribute Mapping Embedding (AME) modules designed to map attributes into vectors and align them with a subset of the latent vectors in a Variational AutoEncoder (VAE). This part of the latent vector will be disentangled from the remaining latent vectors by minimizing mutual information. A classifier is then trained using the mean parameters of the latent vectors from the VAE. translated_title: 基于属性高斯估计的解耦表示学习方法用于医学声音诊断
translated_abstract: 深度学习具有强大的特征提取能力。然而，深度神经网络缺乏公平性和可解释性，这限制了其在医学领域的应用。本文提出了一种解耦表示学习框架，名为基于属性高斯估计的解耦表示（AGEDR），该框架包含属性映射嵌入（AME）模块，旨在将属性映射为向量，并将其与变分自编码器（VAE）中的潜在向量子集对齐。通过最小化互信息，这部分潜在向量将与其余潜在向量实现解耦。随后，利用VAE潜在向量的均值参数训练分类器。大量实验表明，AGEDR的性能优于传统分类模型和现有的解耦表示学习方法。消融实验也进一步验证了……
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为AGEDR的解耦表示学习框架，通过属性映射嵌入模块将属性向量与变分自编码器的潜在向量对齐，并借助最小化互信息实现解耦，从而提升医学声音诊断的性能与可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AGEDR, a disentangled representation learning framework that aligns attribute mapping embeddings with a subset of VAE latent vectors and disentangles them by minimizing mutual information, improving both performance and interpretability in medical sound diagnosis.
